name: coder
description: Secure environments for developers and their agents
one_liner: Lets a company give every developer (and every AI coding agent) a full, secure development computer in the cloud instead of on their laptop, so nothing sensitive ever sits on a personal device.
buyer: An IT security lead at a company with contractors or remote developers who needs consistent, controllable dev environments without shipping laptops or trusting home machines.
business_use_cases: A company with remote contractors gives each one a locked-down cloud dev environment instead of company laptops, cutting hardware costs and security risk.
An enterprise running AI coding agents at scale isolates each agent's work in its own disposable environment, so a bad agent action can't touch production systems.
A managed-IT provider offers 'developer environment as a service' for startups that don't want to run their own infrastructure for this.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed setup and hosting of team-wide cloud dev environments for companies
Provide security-hardening consulting for companies running AI agents in production-adjacent environments

steal_this: This weekend, package a pre-configured, security-hardened environment template for a specific compliance need (e.g. SOC 2 dev environments) and sell it as a starter kit.
